metadata.description: Publishes an approved revision to allowlisted SharePoint. Phase 5 completes HTML→PDF binary steps; this stub defines the trigger contract.
metadata.trigger: When dr_document status becomes approved OR manual Publish command

Upload_to_SharePoint.description: Create file in allowlisted library; filename includes document id + contentrevision
